research_question: Are legal action choices causally distinguishable by actual rewards on unseen seeds, and can simple FIT-trained equal-information baselines outperform an untrained fixed policy? No claims of native learning, unknown-family transfer or scientific admission.

design.fit_exposures: 2 families × 4 seeds × 4 arms = 32 real FIT episodes; identical original public data for every fitted policy
design.check_exposures: 2 families × 2 seeds × 4 arms = 16 real CHECK action-outcome episodes; one frozen diagnostic/veto only
design.dev_exposures: 2 families × 4 seeds × 4 arms = 32 real DEV action-outcome episodes, consumed once and never revisited
design.selection_before_evidence: All fitted policies choose based on FIT data only. CHECK is read-only diagnostic; no fitting or thresholds update before DEV.
design.controls_note: Task-family control explicitly receives known task identity at inference, so comparisons against task-blind controls are not representation-matched; use as upper-bound diagnostic, not a fair native-learning comparison.
design.honest_scoring: For each held-out seed, record each legal action's actual independent reset episode reward and selected return for each frozen policy. No synthetic oracle or policy access to held-out rewards before predictions.
design.partial_causal_control: Independent environment reset/identical seed with original sources for each action; no guaranteed counterfactual state equivalence unless matched initial state is separately verified. Record initial public observation hashes and source.
design.calibration: Action distinguishability: within each family at least 3 of 4 DEV seeds show max-min reward >0.05; comparator learnability: at least one fully fitted family-aware conventional policy improves over fixed arm0 by >=0.01 mean total public reward on DEV in EACH family. If either fails, benchmark NOT_QUALIFIED. If both hold, benchmark CALIBRATED_PUBLIC_DEV_ONLY, never new scientific transfer claim.
design.negative_policy: All sources, effects, zero spans, ties, negative/control losses, skipped/failed tasks, and original K4F no-go preserved. No post-result changes to action menu, seeds, horizon, thresholds or model types. Infra errors block rather than count as scientific negatives.
